description: Versioned provider manifest written by every ingest cycle into the sanitized source root as manifest.json. The generic JavaScript status scanner consumes only this manifest and the wiki pages; it contains no provider-specific code. Bump the version on any breaking change; conformance fixtures in the same directory keep the Python and JavaScript validators in agreement.

fields.version: manifest contract version (integer); the scanner rejects versions it does not support
fields.source: provider key, matching the sanitized source directory name (lowercase letters, digits, underscore, hyphen)
fields.generated_at: Unix timestamp in whole seconds of the producing cycle
fields.wiki_root: optional; Wiki subtree of this provider relative to the wiki source root, either '.' or a normalized relative POSIX path; pages are attributed to the manifest with the longest matching wiki_root
fields.items: one entry per published source; sources that failed validation are listed under errors instead
fields.revoked: one entry per revoked source_key; revoked sources have no item
fields.errors: content-free error reports for sources that could not be published

itemFields.source_key: stable identity of the source within the provider
itemFields.source_path: normalized relative POSIX path of the sanitized source file inside the source root
itemFields.wiki_path: normalized relative POSIX path of the wiki source page inside the wiki source root
itemFields.source_revision: matches the ingest status contract revision pattern (lowercase SHA-256 hex)
itemFields.frontmatter: object with the exact frontmatter the wiki page must carry; frontmatter.source_revision must equal source_revision
itemFields.claim: non-empty object mapping frontmatter field names to string values that identify this source on its wiki page

revokedFields.claim: the same identity the source's wiki page carries

errorFields.path: optional normalized relative path inside the source root
errorFields.error: required, content-free error description; never source content

reservedNames.manifest.json: reserved at the root of every source directory; source files with this name are quarantined and never published

wikiRoots.description: Each manifest declares wiki_root: the provider's wiki page subtree relative to the wiki source root ('.' for providers that own the whole tree). A page is attributed to the manifest with the longest matching wiki_root; wiki_roots must be unique across sources.

compatibility.scannerSupport: The scanner supports manifest version 1 and reports every other version as an invalid source instead of guessing.
compatibility.deprecation: Breaking changes bump the version. A new version is only introduced together with scanner support, and the previous version stays readable for one release cycle before removal. Unknown contracts and versions are never silently ignored.
